package ai // import "github.com/mrsibe/goat/ai"

Package ai defines the provider-neutral message, tool, request, and streaming
contracts used by the agent runtime.

Stability: GOAT is pre-1.0 in v0.4 and may still make breaking changes. After
v1.0, the exported API follows the policy in STABILITY.md at the repository
root.

FUNCTIONS

func CloneRawMessage(raw json.RawMessage) json.RawMessage
    CloneRawMessage deep-copies a JSON payload.

func IsRetryable(err error) bool
    IsRetryable reports whether an error represents a transient provider or
    transport failure. APIError.Retryable is authoritative when set.

func Retry(ctx context.Context, policy RetryPolicy, op func(context.Context) error) error
    Retry runs op until it succeeds, returns a non-retryable error, or exhausts
    the configured retry budget. Context cancellation interrupts backoff.

func RetryDelay(policy RetryPolicy, attempt int) time.Duration
    RetryDelay returns the delay before the given 1-indexed retry attempt.


TYPES

type API string
    API identifies a provider protocol.

const (
	APIOpenAICompletions    API = "openai-completions"
	APIOpenAIResponses      API = "openai-responses"
	APIAzureOpenAIResponses API = "azure-openai-responses"
	APIGoogleGenerativeAI   API = "google-generative-ai"
	APIAnthropicMessages    API = "anthropic-messages"
)
type APIError struct {
	Provider   string
	StatusCode int
	Code       string
	Message    string
	RequestID  string
	Retryable  bool
	Err        error
}
    APIError is the provider-neutral error returned by model adapters.

func (e *APIError) Error() string

func (e *APIError) Unwrap() error

type BlockType string
    BlockType identifies a content block within a message.

const (
	BlockText     BlockType = "text"
	BlockThinking BlockType = "thinking"
	BlockImage    BlockType = "image"
	BlockToolCall BlockType = "tool_call"
)
type ContentBlock struct {
	Type              BlockType     `json:"type"`
	Text              string        `json:"text,omitempty"`
	TextSignature     string        `json:"text_signature,omitempty"`
	Thinking          string        `json:"thinking,omitempty"`
	ThinkingSignature string        `json:"thinking_signature,omitempty"`
	ID                string        `json:"id,omitempty"`
	Redacted          bool          `json:"redacted,omitempty"`
	Image             *ImageContent `json:"image,omitempty"`
	ToolCall          *ToolCall     `json:"tool_call,omitempty"`
}
    ContentBlock is one piece of provider-neutral message content.

func CloneContentBlock(block ContentBlock) ContentBlock
    CloneContentBlock deep-copies a content block.

func CloneContentBlocks(blocks []ContentBlock) []ContentBlock
    CloneContentBlocks deep-copies content blocks.

type Event struct {
	Type          EventType      `json:"type"`
	ContentIndex  int            `json:"content_index,omitempty"`
	Text          string         `json:"text,omitempty"`
	TextDelta     string         `json:"text_delta,omitempty"`
	Thinking      string         `json:"thinking,omitempty"`
	ThinkingDelta string         `json:"thinking_delta,omitempty"`
	ToolCall      *ToolCall      `json:"tool_call,omitempty"`
	ToolCallDelta *ToolCallDelta `json:"tool_call_delta,omitempty"`
	Partial       *Message       `json:"partial,omitempty"`
	Message       *Message       `json:"message,omitempty"`
	Usage         *Usage         `json:"usage,omitempty"`
	StopReason    StopReason     `json:"stop_reason,omitempty"`
	Err           error          `json:"-"`
	Error         string         `json:"error,omitempty"`
}
    Event is one normalized model stream event. Partial is a deep copy of the
    assistant message accumulated so far. Done carries Message and Usage;
    Error carries Err and the partial message.

type EventType string
    EventType identifies one normalized model stream event.

const (
	EventStart         EventType = "start"
	EventTextStart     EventType = "text_start"
	EventTextDelta     EventType = "text_delta"
	EventTextEnd       EventType = "text_end"
	EventThinkingStart EventType = "thinking_start"
	EventThinkingDelta EventType = "thinking_delta"
	EventThinkingEnd   EventType = "thinking_end"
	EventToolCallStart EventType = "tool_call_start"
	EventToolCallDelta EventType = "tool_call_delta"
	EventToolCallEnd   EventType = "tool_call_end"
	EventUsage         EventType = "usage"
	EventDone          EventType = "done"
	EventError         EventType = "error"
)
type ImageContent struct {
	Data      string `json:"data,omitempty"`
	URL       string `json:"url,omitempty"`
	MediaType string `json:"media_type,omitempty"`
}
    ImageContent is an inline image or image URL.

type Message struct {
	Role              Role            `json:"role"`
	Content           []ContentBlock  `json:"content"`
	ToolCallID        string          `json:"tool_call_id,omitempty"`
	ToolName          string          `json:"tool_name,omitempty"`
	IsError           bool            `json:"is_error,omitempty"`
	Timestamp         int64           `json:"timestamp,omitempty"`
	Details           json.RawMessage `json:"details,omitempty"`
	StructuredContent json.RawMessage `json:"structured_content,omitempty"`
	Usage             *Usage          `json:"usage,omitempty"`
	StopReason        StopReason      `json:"stop_reason,omitempty"`
	Provider          string          `json:"provider,omitempty"`
	Model             string          `json:"model,omitempty"`
	API               API             `json:"api,omitempty"`
	ResponseModel     string          `json:"response_model,omitempty"`
	ResponseID        string          `json:"response_id,omitempty"`
	ErrorMessage      string          `json:"error_message,omitempty"`
	DurationMs        int64           `json:"duration_ms,omitempty"`
}
    Message is a provider-neutral chat message. Assistant messages use tool-call
    blocks for model-requested tools; tool messages use ToolCallID to correlate
    the result with its request.

func CloneMessage(message Message) Message
    CloneMessage deep-copies a message.

func CloneMessages(messages []Message) []Message
    CloneMessages deep-copies a message slice.

func TextMessage(role Role, text string) Message
    TextMessage creates a message containing one text block.

func ToolMessage(callID, toolName, text string) Message
    ToolMessage creates a successful text tool-result message.

func ToolResultMessage(callID, toolName string, content []ContentBlock, isError bool) Message
    ToolResultMessage creates a tool-result message with arbitrary content
    blocks.

func ToolTextMessage(callID, toolName, text string, isError bool) Message
    ToolTextMessage creates a tool-result message containing one text block.

func (m Message) Text() string
    Text returns all text blocks in the message joined without separators.

func (m Message) Thinking() string
    Thinking returns all thinking blocks joined without separators.

func (m Message) ToolCalls() []ToolCall
    ToolCalls returns all tool-call blocks in source order.

type Model interface {
	Info() ModelInfo
	Stream(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Stream, error)
}
    Model is the boundary between the agent loop and a model provider.

type ModelInfo struct {
	Provider                 string `json:"provider"`
	Model                    string `json:"model"`
	API                      API    `json:"api"`
	ContextWindow            int    `json:"context_window,omitempty"`
	MaxOutputTokens          int    `json:"max_output_tokens,omitempty"`
	SupportsTools            bool   `json:"supports_tools"`
	SupportsImages           bool   `json:"supports_images,omitempty"`
	SupportsToolResultImages bool   `json:"supports_tool_result_images,omitempty"`
	SupportsThinking         bool   `json:"supports_thinking,omitempty"`
}
    ModelInfo describes a concrete model and the protocol capabilities exposed
    by its adapter. Model-specific limitations still apply.

type Request struct {
	Messages []Message      `json:"messages"`
	Tools    []ToolSpec     `json:"tools,omitempty"`
	Options  RequestOptions `json:"options,omitempty"`
}
    Request is one provider-neutral model turn.

type RequestOptions struct {
	Temperature          *float64   `json:"temperature,omitempty"`
	TopP                 *float64   `json:"top_p,omitempty"`
	MaxTokens            int        `json:"max_tokens,omitempty"`
	ToolChoice           ToolChoice `json:"tool_choice,omitempty"`
	SessionID            string     `json:"session_id,omitempty"`
	ReasoningEffort      string     `json:"reasoning_effort,omitempty"`
	ThinkingBudgetTokens int        `json:"thinking_budget_tokens,omitempty"`
}
    RequestOptions contains per-request sampling and routing controls. Empty
    values leave the provider default in place.

type RetryPolicy struct {
	Enabled    bool
	MaxRetries int
	BaseDelay  time.Duration
	MaxDelay   time.Duration
}
    RetryPolicy controls bounded retries with exponential backoff. MaxRetries is
    the number of retries after the initial call.

type Role string
    Role identifies the author of a message.

const (
	RoleSystem    Role = "system"
	RoleUser      Role = "user"
	RoleAssistant Role = "assistant"
	RoleTool      Role = "tool"
)
type StopReason string
    StopReason describes why a model turn ended.

const (
	StopReasonStop      StopReason = "stop"
	StopReasonLength    StopReason = "length"
	StopReasonToolCalls StopReason = "tool_calls"
	StopReasonError     StopReason = "error"
	StopReasonAborted   StopReason = "aborted"
)
type Stream interface {
	Next() (Event, error)
	Close() error
}
    Stream yields normalized model events. Next returns io.EOF after the final
    event. The caller always closes the stream.

type ToolCall struct {
	ID               string          `json:"id"`
	ItemID           string          `json:"item_id,omitempty"`
	Name             string          `json:"name"`
	Arguments        json.RawMessage `json:"arguments"`
	ArgumentsError   string          `json:"arguments_error,omitempty"`
	ThoughtSignature string          `json:"thought_signature,omitempty"`
	Namespace        string          `json:"namespace,omitempty"`
}
    ToolCall is a completed tool invocation requested by the model.

func CloneToolCall(call ToolCall) ToolCall
    CloneToolCall deep-copies a tool call.

type ToolCallDelta struct {
	ID             string `json:"id,omitempty"`
	Name           string `json:"name,omitempty"`
	ArgumentsDelta string `json:"arguments_delta,omitempty"`
}
    ToolCallDelta is one streamed fragment of a tool call. ContentIndex on the
    enclosing Event identifies the content block. ID and Name are complete
    values when present; ArgumentsDelta is incremental.

type ToolChoice struct {
	Mode ToolChoiceMode `json:"mode,omitempty"`
	Name string         `json:"name,omitempty"`
}
    ToolChoice selects a tool-use policy. Name is used only with
    ToolChoiceNamed.

type ToolChoiceMode string
    ToolChoiceMode controls how the model may use tools.

const (
	ToolChoiceAuto     ToolChoiceMode = "auto"
	ToolChoiceNone     ToolChoiceMode = "none"
	ToolChoiceRequired ToolChoiceMode = "required"
	ToolChoiceNamed    ToolChoiceMode = "named"
)
type ToolSpec struct {
	Name        string         `json:"name"`
	Description string         `json:"description"`
	Parameters  map[string]any `json:"parameters"`
}
    ToolSpec describes a tool to the model.

type Usage struct {
	PromptTokens     int64 `json:"prompt_tokens"`
	CompletionTokens int64 `json:"completion_tokens"`
	CacheReadTokens  int64 `json:"cache_read_tokens,omitempty"`
	CacheWriteTokens int64 `json:"cache_write_tokens,omitempty"`
	ReasoningTokens  int64 `json:"reasoning_tokens,omitempty"`
	TotalTokens      int64 `json:"total_tokens"`
}
    Usage contains token counts reported by a model provider.

func (u *Usage) Add(other Usage)
    Add accumulates another usage report.
